glosses.notes: 迷人 means charming or fascinating in a way that strongly attracts people.

examples.sentence: 夜里河边的灯光很迷人，所以很多人吃完饭以后还是会慢慢走过去看一会儿。
她那种安静又自然的笑很迷人，所以第一次见面的人通常很快就会记住她。
这个地方最迷人的不是楼有多高，而是早上太阳出来以后整条街都显得特别安静。

example_translations.translation: The lights by the river at night are very charming, so many people still slowly walk over to look for a while after finishing dinner.
Her quiet and natural smile is very charming, so people meeting her for the first time usually remember her very quickly.
The most charming thing about this place is not how tall the buildings are, but how especially calm the whole street seems after the sun comes up in the morning.

glosses.notes: 密 means dense, closely packed, or tightly arranged.

examples.sentence: 山里的树长得很密，所以太阳出来以后，地上还是有很多地方照不到光。
这页字写得太密，老人看了一会儿就觉得眼睛很累，所以让孩子再抄得大一点。
最近安排得太密，母亲说如果今天还不早点休息，后面身体很容易又不舒服。

example_translations.translation: The trees in the mountains grow very densely, so even after the sun comes out there are still many places on the ground that it cannot reach.
The writing on this page is too dense, and after looking for a while the old man felt his eyes getting tired, so he asked the child to copy it larger.
The schedule has been too packed lately, and Mother said that if there is still no early rest today, the body will easily feel unwell again later.

glosses.notes: 密度 means density, the amount of something within a certain space or range.

examples.sentence: 这个地方人口密度很高，所以一到早上，路上和车里看上去总是特别满。
老师说这篇文章的信息密度太大，所以第一次读的时候不懂也正常，后面要慢慢分开看。
老师说这本书每一页的信息密度都很高，所以看得太快反而更容易看不懂。

example_translations.translation: The population density in this place is very high, so once morning comes, the roads and the cars always look especially full.
The teacher said the information density of this article is too high, so it is normal not to understand it the first time and it should be read piece by piece later.
The teacher said that the information density on every page of this book is very high, so reading too quickly actually makes it easier not to understand.

glosses.notes: 蜜蜂 means a bee, the small insect known for collecting nectar and making honey.

examples.sentence: 花开得最多的时候，院子里常有蜜蜂飞来飞去，所以孩子站在旁边看了很久也不想走。
老人说蜜蜂虽然小，可是每天做的事一点也不少，所以人看久了会觉得很有意思。
母亲提醒孩子看见蜜蜂先别乱动，因为你越紧张，它反而越可能在你身边一直飞。

example_translations.translation: When the flowers are blooming the most, there are often bees flying around in the yard, so the child stood nearby watching for a long time and did not want to leave.
The old man said that although bees are small, the things they do every day are not few at all, so watching them for a long time feels very interesting.
Mother reminded the child not to move around when seeing a bee, because the more nervous you get, the more likely it is to keep flying around near you.

glosses.notes: 密集 means tightly concentrated, closely packed, or happening with very little space between.

examples.sentence: 这几天会议安排得太密集，所以大家连安静吃一顿饭的时间都很难找出来。
这一带小店开得很密集，走几步就是一家，所以外地来的人常说这里很方便。
问题在短时间里密集出现的时候，经理没有先怪谁，而是先把前面做过的事重新看一遍。

example_translations.translation: The meetings have been scheduled too densely these days, so it has been hard for everyone even to find time to eat one quiet meal.
The small shops in this area are very densely spread out, and after just a few steps there is another one, so people from out of town often say this place is very convenient.
When problems appeared in a concentrated way over a short time, the manager did not blame anyone first, but instead went back through what had been done earlier.

glosses.notes: 棉 means cotton, including cotton filling and cotton material.

examples.sentence: 这件外套里面加了很多棉，所以看着不算太厚，可是真正穿到外面以后还是很暖和。
母亲挑被子的时候先摸里面的棉，因为外面样子再好看，晚上盖着不舒服也没有用。
医生说小伤口可以先用干净的棉轻轻按一会儿，这样比较容易把前面的血止住。

example_translations.translation: A lot of cotton has been added inside this coat, so it does not look too thick, but once it is really worn outside it is still very warm.
When choosing a quilt, Mother first feels the cotton inside, because no matter how nice it looks on the outside, it is useless if it is uncomfortable at night.
The doctor said that for a small wound one can first press it gently for a while with clean cotton, because that makes it easier to stop the earlier bleeding.

glosses.notes: 免 means to exempt someone from something or to avoid a certain trouble or cost.

examples.sentence: 经理把前面的事先安排好，就是想免后面很多麻烦。
医生说按时睡觉不能免所有问题，可是至少能让身体在后面少受一点影响。
他把前面的路先问清楚，就是想免去后面来回找人的麻烦，这样做也确实省了不少时间。

example_translations.translation: The manager arranged the earlier matters in advance because he wanted to avoid a lot of trouble later.
The doctor said sleeping on time cannot avoid all problems, but at least it can help the body suffer a little less later.
He asked clearly about the route ahead first because he wanted to avoid the trouble of going back and forth looking for people later, and this really did save quite a lot of time.

glosses.notes: 勉强 can mean being reluctant, or forcing oneself to do something with difficulty.

examples.sentence: 身体还没完全好，可是他还是勉强把前面答应好的工作做完了，回家以后才真正休息。
她不想勉强孩子马上回答，因为有些问题本来就需要时间慢慢想清楚。
父亲听完以后只是勉强点了点头，谁都看得出来他心里其实还没有完全同意。

example_translations.translation: His body had not completely recovered, but he still forced himself to finish the work he had promised earlier, and only after getting home did he really rest.
She did not want to force the child to answer immediately, because some questions naturally need time to be thought through slowly.
After listening, Father only nodded reluctantly, and everyone could tell that in his heart he had not completely agreed yet.

glosses.notes: 免税 means tax-free or exempt from tax.

examples.sentence: 机场里的免税店一到晚上还是很多人，因为不少人都想在上飞机以前再看看有没有合适的东西。
经理说这批产品如果真的能免税，公司后面的压力就会小很多，所以大家都在等通知。
他原来没打算买，可是一看那家店写着免税，还是进去转了一圈，想比较一下价格。

example_translations.translation: The duty-free shops at the airport are still crowded once evening comes, because many people want one more look before boarding to see whether there is something suitable.
The manager said that if this batch of products can really be tax-free, the company’s pressure later will become much smaller, so everyone is waiting for the notice.
He had not originally planned to buy anything, but once he saw that the shop said tax-free, he still went in for a look, wanting to compare the prices.

glosses.notes: 免疫 means to become immune or resistant, either physically or sometimes figuratively.

examples.sentence: 医生说打完针以后，身体不会马上免疫，所以前面几天还是要像平常一样小心一点。
老师说一个人不能对别人的意见完全免疫，因为真正有用的话，听进去以后常会帮你看清问题。
那位老人年轻时常生病，后来慢慢注意运动和吃饭，身体才比原来更有免疫能力。

example_translations.translation: The doctor said that after the injection, the body will not become immune immediately, so during the first few days one still has to be as careful as usual.
The teacher said a person cannot be completely immune to other people’s opinions, because words that are truly useful often help you see the problem clearly after you take them in.
That old man often got sick when he was young, but later he gradually paid attention to exercise and eating, and only then did his body have stronger immunity than before.

glosses.notes: 面部 means the facial area or facial part of the body.

examples.sentence: 医生先看了看他的面部，然后才问前面是怎么碰到的，因为眼睛那一带还有一点红。
她一紧张，面部表情就会一下变得很不自然，所以老师总提醒她先慢慢呼吸再开口。
演员在镜子前练了很久面部动作，想让后面那个短短的镜头也能把情绪说明白。

example_translations.translation: The doctor first looked at his face and only then asked how he had been hit earlier, because the area around the eye was still a little red.
As soon as she gets nervous, her facial expression becomes very unnatural, so the teacher always reminds her to breathe slowly before speaking.
The actor practiced facial movements for a long time in front of the mirror, wanting even that short shot later to make the emotion clear.

glosses.notes: 面粉 means flour used to make dough, bread, noodles, and other foods.

examples.sentence: 母亲和面以前总会先把面粉慢慢过一遍，因为这样做出来的东西口感会更细一点。
父亲看面粉放得久了，所以先打开，后面没有问题才用。
老人说以前家里条件一般，可是只要过节，母亲还是会想办法留一点面粉给孩子做点心。

example_translations.translation: Before making dough, Mother always slowly sifts the flour once, because things made this way will have a finer texture.
Father saw that the flour had been stored for a long time, so he opened it first and only used it later after there proved to be no problem.
The old man said that in the past the family’s conditions were average, but whenever there was a holiday, Mother still found a way to save a little flour to make snacks for the children.

glosses.notes: 面子 means face, reputation, or the dignity someone wants to preserve in front of others.

examples.sentence: 他在很多人前面不给别人面子，所以一句话说完，大家都觉得气氛很紧张。
父亲说做事当然要认真，可是认真不等于处处争赢，有时候给别人一点面子，事情反而更好谈。
她本来想直接指出问题，后来还是想了想，决定先换一种说法，免得让前面的老人觉得没面子。

example_translations.translation: He gave the other person no face in front of many people, so after that one sentence everyone felt the atmosphere was very tense.

Father said that of course one should be serious in doing things, but being serious does not mean trying to win everywhere; sometimes giving others a little face actually makes things easier to discuss.
She had originally wanted to point out the problem directly, but later she thought it over and decided to phrase it differently first, so that the old man in front would not feel embarrassed.

glosses.notes: 描绘 means to depict or portray something in words or images.

examples.sentence: 这本书把海边冬天的样子描绘得很安静，所以人刚看几页，心里就会慢慢跟着平下来。
老师说要真正描绘一个地方，不只是写它有什么，还要写人在那里时心里有什么感觉。
画家没有急着动笔，而是先站远一点看了很久，想清楚以后再描绘前面那片很淡的光。

example_translations.translation: This book depicts the look of winter by the sea in a very calm way, so after just a few pages the reader’s heart gradually settles down as well.
The teacher said that to truly depict a place, one must not only write what is there, but also what people feel in their hearts when they are there.
The painter did not rush to start, but first stood farther away and looked for a long time, wanting to think clearly before depicting that faint light in front.

glosses.notes: 描写 means to describe something in written or spoken form.

examples.sentence: 这篇文章描写母亲做饭时的那些小动作特别细，所以很多人一读就会想到自己家里的厨房。
老师让大家注意作者怎样描写夜里的声音，因为真正让人紧张的地方往往不是看见了什么。
他原来只会描写事情怎么发生，后来读得多了，才慢慢学会描写人心里那些说不出的变化。

example_translations.translation: This article describes those small movements of Mother while cooking in very fine detail, so many people think of their own kitchen as soon as they read it.
The teacher asked everyone to pay attention to how the author describes the sounds of the night, because what truly makes people tense is often not what they see.
He originally only knew how to describe how things happened, and only after reading more later did he gradually learn how to describe the changes in people’s hearts that cannot easily be said aloud.

glosses.notes: 妙 means wonderful, clever, or excellent in a pleasing way.

examples.sentence: 这个办法真妙，因为它没有让问题变少，可是一下就让大家看明白前面最重要的地方在哪里。
老人听完以后笑着说这一招很妙，看着简单，可是真正想到的人其实并不多。
她把两种普通的颜色放在一起，结果出来的感觉特别妙，所以连老师也站在那里看了很久。

example_translations.translation: This method is truly wonderful, because it did not reduce the problem itself, but it instantly let everyone see where the most important part earlier was.
After hearing it, the old man smiled and said that this trick was excellent; it looks simple, but in fact not many people truly think of it.
She put two ordinary colors together, and the resulting feeling was especially wonderful, so even the teacher stood there looking for a long time.

glosses.notes: 灭 means to extinguish something like a fire or light, or to wipe something out.

examples.sentence: 路边的火一灭，大家心里就轻松一点，也不用一直站在那里看。
大家先看路边的火灭没有，后面才敢放心走过去。
如果不先把灯灭了，孩子晚上就很难安静睡着，所以母亲每次都会先坐在床边一会儿。

example_translations.translation: Once the fire by the roadside went out, everyone felt a little more relaxed and no longer had to keep standing there watching.
Everyone first checked whether the fire by the roadside had gone out, and only then did they dare walk past with peace of mind.
If the light is not turned off first, it is hard for the child to fall asleep quietly at night, so each time Mother first sits by the bed for a while.

glosses.notes: 民歌 means a folk song passed down among ordinary people.

examples.sentence: 老人年轻的时候很会唱民歌，所以每次家里人一坐到一起，他总会先开口唱上一段。
这场演出最打动人的不是灯和衣服，而是最后那首民歌一响起来，很多人都安静了下来。
老师说民歌能一直留下来，不只是因为好听，也是因为里面常有普通人的日子和感情。

example_translations.translation: The old man sang folk songs very well when he was young, so every time the family sat together, he would always begin by singing a verse first.
The most moving thing in this performance was not the lights or the clothes, but that once the final folk song began, many people fell quiet.
The teacher said folk songs can continue to survive not only because they sound good, but also because they often contain the lives and feelings of ordinary people.

glosses.notes: 民间 refers to the folk sphere or what exists among ordinary people rather than official institutions.

examples.sentence: 这个办法最早是在民间传开的，所以书上写得不多，可是很多老人都知道。
老师说很多民间故事看着简单，可是要真讲清楚里面的意思，其实并不容易。
这种药方是不是有效，民间一直有很多不同说法，所以医生提醒大家还是要小心一点。

example_translations.translation: This method first spread among the people, so not much is written about it in books, but many older people know it.
The teacher said many folk stories look simple, but to truly explain the meaning inside them is actually not easy.
Whether this prescription is effective has long had many different explanations among the people, so the doctor reminded everyone to stay a little careful.

glosses.notes: 民俗 means folk custom, the traditional ways of living and celebrating among the people.

examples.sentence: 这次展览把当地的民俗放在最前面介绍，所以外地来的人一进门就能知道这里以前怎么过节。
老师说研究民俗不能只看表面热闹，还要知道那些做法为什么会一直留到今天。
孩子原来觉得民俗离自己很远，后来跟着家里人过了几次老节，才觉得里面很有意思。

example_translations.translation: This exhibition introduces the local folk customs first, so as soon as people from out of town enter, they can know how festivals used to be celebrated here.
The teacher said that studying folk customs cannot only look at lively appearances, but must also know why those practices have remained until today.
The child originally felt folk customs were far away from his own life, but after celebrating a few old festivals with the family, he came to feel that they were very interesting.

glosses.notes: 民宿 means a homestay or family-run guesthouse for travelers.

examples.sentence: 这家民宿房间不算大，可是窗外就是山，所以很多来过的人第二年还想再住一次。
我们到的时候天已经黑了，民宿的老板还是一直站在门口等，怕外地来的客人找不到路。
她选民宿的时候先不看贵不贵，而是看晚上安不安静，因为第二天一早还得继续赶路。

example_translations.translation: The rooms in this homestay are not very large, but the mountains are right outside the window, so many people who have stayed here want to come again the next year.
By the time we arrived it was already dark, yet the owner of the homestay still kept waiting at the door, worried that guests from out of town would not find the way.
When choosing a homestay, she first does not look at whether it is expensive, but at whether it will be quiet at night, because they still have to continue the journey early the next morning.

glosses.notes: 民众 means the general public or the broad mass of ordinary people.

examples.sentence: 这条消息一出来，很多民众马上开始关心后面会不会有新的安排，因为事情和大家都有关系。
经理说面对民众的时候，最重要的不是把话说得多漂亮，而是让人听完以后真的明白。
前面的雨太大了，所以当地民众先把孩子和老人送到安全的地方，再回头去看别的东西。

example_translations.translation: As soon as this news came out, many members of the public immediately began caring about whether there would be new arrangements later, because the matter concerns everyone.
The manager said that when facing the public, the most important thing is not how beautifully you speak, but whether people truly understand after listening.
The earlier rain was too heavy, so the local people first sent the children and elderly to a safe place and only then turned back to look after other things.

glosses.notes: 民主 means democracy, and it can also describe a democratic way of deciding things.

examples.sentence: 老师说真正的民主不是每个人同时说很多话，而是大家都有机会把自己的意思讲清楚。
这个小组后来决定用更民主的办法讨论，因为原来的方式总让少数几个人一直在讲话。
父亲年轻时不太懂民主这个词，后来听得多了，才慢慢明白它和每个人的生活也有关系。

example_translations.translation: The teacher said true democracy is not everyone speaking a lot at the same time, but everyone having a chance to explain their own ideas clearly.
That group later decided to discuss things in a more democratic way, because the original method always let only a few people keep talking.
When Father was young, he did not really understand the word democracy, and only after hearing it more later did he gradually realize that it also has to do with everyone’s life.

glosses.notes: 名额 means a quota or the limited number of places available for something.

examples.sentence: 这次出去学习的名额不多，所以老师先把条件说清楚，免得后面有人觉得不公平。
公司原来只准备了两个名额，可是报名的人比想的多很多，所以经理又回去重新讨论。
她知道自己未必能拿到名额，可是还是认真把材料都准备好了，因为不想先放弃机会。

example_translations.translation: There are not many places for going out to study this time, so the teacher explained the conditions clearly first, so that later no one would feel it was unfair.
The company had originally prepared only two places, but far more people signed up than expected, so the manager went back to discuss it again.
She knew she might not get a place, but she still prepared all the materials carefully, because she did not want to give up the chance in advance.

glosses.notes: 明亮 means bright in light, color, or expression.

examples.sentence: 这间屋子虽然不大，可是窗很多，所以一到早上里面就特别明亮，连角落也看得很清楚。
她把灯换了以后，房间比原来明亮很多，所以晚上看书的时候眼睛也轻松一点。
老人说孩子的眼睛总是那么明亮，所以就算一句话不说，别人也能看出他心里有很多想法。

example_translations.translation: Although this room is not large, it has many windows, so once morning comes the inside becomes especially bright, and even the corners can be seen clearly.
After she changed the light, the room became much brighter than before, so her eyes also felt a little more relaxed when reading at night.
The old man said the child’s eyes are always so bright that even without saying a word, others can tell he has many thoughts in his heart.
